notes.title: Mech Skeleton 18-Dec-17-Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Really excited to get this update out!! 

Loads of changes were made to the post processing and lighting.

If you get a free minute, let us know what you think, any feedback would be really awesome.

Both the enemy and friendly soldiers have new animations and combat systems,  more dialog for the enemy bots was also added.

Based on player feedback,  combat on the first ground assault level has been tightened up.

The player weapon and shield system was rebuilt to help improve performance.

I also fixed a bug that was breaking the controller haptic feedback, also added more haptic feedback.

For the most part this update was more about polishing the game, based on ideas and suggestions from players.

Please let us know if you have any thoughts on ways I can continue to improve the game.

Have fun!

Cheers

notes.title: Mech Skeleton - 03-June-17 Update
notes.content:
Hello everybody 

Just an update to adjust a few things based on player feedback 

The update includes the following changes.
  New shield system, the player can now carry the energy shield.
  Fixed problem on Stealth level which caused the enemy AI to get stuck.
  Slight change to some enemy behaviors.
  Added death animations to Heavy walker enemy.
  Improved lighting and draw distance on outside street levels.
  Improved lighting on indoor levels.

Please continue to let us know if you any problems.
